verdict.rationale: Pandoc's documented behavior for multiple inputs is to concatenate them into a single document before parsing. That is the opposite of converting each file separately with per-file results, and the evidence shows no folder or batch mode. Batch conversion would need user-side shell loops or CI scripting (e.g. GitHub Actions), which are workarounds or host-platform capabilities and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can convert a whole folder or list of files in one run, with per-file results
